actions.description: List all repositories accessible to this Github App
actions.name: repositories

actions.description: Search file contents across indexed GitHub repositories using code-search qualifiers.
actions.name: search-code

q.description: Code search query with keywords and GitHub qualifiers. Example: "addClass in:file language:js repo:jquery/jquery".

sort.description: Sort order for results. The only supported value is "indexed", which sorts by how recently GitHub indexed the file.

order.description: Direction of the sort. Only applies when sort is provided.

per_page.description: Number of results to return per page, from 1 to 100. GitHub defaults to 30.

page.description: Page number of results to return, starting at 1. GitHub defaults to 1.

ActionInput_github_app_searchcode.description: Parameters for searching code across GitHub repositories.

total_count.description: Total number of matching files, up to the GitHub search result cap.

incomplete_results.description: Whether the search timed out before returning all possible matches.

name.description: File name of the matching code file.

path.description: Full path of the file within the repository.

sha.description: Git blob SHA of the matching file.

url.description: API URL of the matching file.

html_url.description: Web URL of the matching file.

git_url.description: Git API URL of the matching blob.

node_id.description: GraphQL node ID of the repository.

name.description: Repository name without the owner prefix.

full_name.description: Repository name including the owner, for example "jquery/jquery".

description.description: Repository description, or null when none is set.

fork.description: Whether the repository is a fork.

id.description: Numeric GitHub user ID of the repository owner.

avatar_url.description: URL of the repository owner avatar image.

html_url.description: Web URL of the repository owner profile.

repository.description: Repository that contains the matching file.

score.description: Relevance score assigned by GitHub search.

file_size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

language.description: Detected programming language of the file, or null when GitHub cannot detect one.

last_modified_at.description: Timestamp when the file was last modified.

line_numbers.description: Line numbers of the match when GitHub includes them.

items.description: Matching code files for the requested page.

next_page.description: Page number to request next. Omitted on the last accessible page.

ActionOutput_github_app_searchcode.description: A page of GitHub code search results.

actions.description: Search commits across indexed repositories by message, author, or metadata qualifiers.

sort.description: Field to sort results by. Omit for best-match ordering.

order.description: Sort direction. Ignored unless sort is provided. Example: "desc".

per_page.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.

page.description: Page number of results to fetch, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

node_id.description: GraphQL node ID of the commit search result.

html_url.description: URL of the commit on GitHub.

comments_url.description: API URL for comments on the commit.

message.description: Full commit message, including the subject and body.

author.description: Git author identity recorded on the commit.

name.description: Name recorded on the Git commit.

email.description: Email address recorded on the Git commit.

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp recorded on the Git commit.

commit.description: Git commit details, including message and author identities.

actions.description: Search issues and pull requests across indexed repositories using GitHub's issue-search qualifiers.
actions.name: search-issues-and-pull-requests

q.description: Free-form issue search keywords and qualifiers appended to the generated query. Example: "memory leak in:title".

repository.description: Limit results to one repository in "owner/repo" format. Example: "octocat/Hello-World".

type.description: Restrict results to issues (is:issue) or pull requests (is:pr). Omit to return both.

state.description: Restrict results to open or closed issues and pull requests.

label.description: Only include items carrying this label. Example: "bug".

assignee.description: Only include items assigned to this GitHub login. Example: "octocat".

author.description: Only include items created by this GitHub login. Example: "octocat".

sort.description: Field used to sort results. Defaults to best match. Example: "created".

order.description: Sort direction for the selected sort field. Defaults to "desc".

per_page.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.

page.description: Page number to fetch, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

ActionInput_github_app_searchissuesandpu.description: Filters and pagination for searching GitHub issues and pull requests.

total_count.description: Total number of items matching the query across all pages.

incomplete_results.description: Whether GitHub timed out before returning every matching result.

id.description: Numeric GitHub issue or pull request ID.

number.description: Repository-scoped issue or pull request number.

state_reason.description: Reason the item was closed, such as "completed" or "not_planned".

html_url.description: URL of the issue or pull request on GitHub.

url.description: REST API URL of the issue or pull request.

repository_url.description: REST API URL of the repository that contains the item.

body.description: Markdown body of the issue or pull request.

user.description: User who created the issue or pull request.

login.description: GitHub login of the user. Example: "octocat".

html_url.description: URL of the user profile on GitHub.

color.description: Six-character hex color of the label without a leading hash.

description.description: Label description, when one is set.

labels.description: Labels currently attached to the issue or pull request.

assignees.description: Users currently assigned to the issue or pull request.

login.description: GitHub login of the user. Example: "octocat".

html_url.description: URL of the user profile on GitHub.

comments.description: Number of comments on the issue or pull request.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the issue or pull request was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the issue or pull request was last updated.

closed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the issue or pull request was closed, if it is closed.

author_association.description: Author relationship to the repository, such as "OWNER", "MEMBER", or "CONTRIBUTOR".

draft.description: Whether the pull request is a draft; only present for pull requests.

is_pull_request.description: Whether the search result is a pull request rather than an issue.

pull_request.description: Pull request-specific URLs and merge details; only present for pull requests.

merged_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the pull request was merged, if it was merged.

html_url.description: URL of the pull request on GitHub.

url.description: REST API URL of the pull request.

diff_url.description: URL of the pull request diff.

patch_url.description: URL of the pull request patch.

score.description: Relevance score assigned by GitHub search.

items.description: Issues and pull requests matching the query for the requested page.

next_page.description: Page number to request next. Omitted on the last accessible page.

ActionOutput_github_app_searchissuesandp.description: Paginated GitHub issue and pull request search results.

actions.description: Search for labels within a specific repository by name or description.
actions.name: search-labels

repository_id.description: Numeric ID of the repository to search labels in. Example: 1224437532

q.description: Search keywords matched against label names and descriptions. Qualifiers are not supported. Example: "bug"

sort.description: Field used to sort the results. Defaults to best match when omitted.

order.description: Sort direction, applied only when sort is set. Defaults to "desc".

per_page.description: Number of results to return per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.

page.description: Page number of results to fetch, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

ActionInput_github_app_searchlabels.description: Parameters for searching labels in a GitHub repository.

total_count.description: Total number of labels matching the search query.

incomplete_results.description: Whether the search timed out and the results may be incomplete.

node_id.description: GraphQL node ID of the label.

color.description: Hex color code of the label without the leading "#".

default.description: Whether this is a default GitHub label.

description.description: Description of the label, or null when it has none.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the label was archived, or null when it is not archived.

login.description: Username of the user who archived the label.

id.description: Numeric ID of the user who archived the label.

node_id.description: GraphQL node ID of the user who archived the label.

avatar_url.description: Avatar URL of the user who archived the label.

html_url.description: GitHub profile URL of the user who archived the label.

archived_by.description: User who archived the label, or null when it is not archived.

score.description: Relevance score assigned by GitHub search.

items.description: Labels matching the search query, ordered by the requested sort.

next_page.description: Page number to request for the next set of results, omitted when there are no more results.

ActionOutput_github_app_searchlabels.description: A page of label search results from a GitHub repository.

actions.description: Search public and accessible repositories using GitHub's repository-search qualifiers.

sort.description: Field to sort results by. Defaults to GitHub best-match relevance when omitted.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to "desc" when `sort` is provided.

per_page.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.

page.description: Page number of results to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

total_count.description: The total number of repositories matching the search query.

incomplete_results.description: Whether the search timed out and returned incomplete results.

id.description: The unique numeric ID of the repository.

node_id.description: The GraphQL node ID of the repository.

name.description: The repository name without the owner prefix.

full_name.description: The repository name including the owner prefix. Example: "NangoHQ/nango".

id.description: The unique numeric ID of the owner.

node_id.description: The GraphQL node ID of the owner.

avatar_url.description: The URL of the owner avatar image.

gravatar_id.description: The owner Gravatar ID, or null when not set.

url.description: The API URL for the owner.

html_url.description: The GitHub web URL for the owner.

site_admin.description: Whether the owner is a GitHub site administrator.

owner.description: The account that owns the repository.

html_url.description: The GitHub web URL for the repository.

description.description: The repository description, or null when none is set.

fork.description: Whether the repository is a fork.

url.description: The API URL for the repository.

created_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the repository was created.

updated_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the repository was last updated.

pushed_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp of the last push, or null when never pushed.

homepage.description: The repository homepage URL, or null when none is set.

stargazers_count.description: The number of users who starred the repository.

watchers_count.description: The number of users watching the repository.

language.description: The primary programming language, or null when undetected.

forks_count.description: The number of forks of the repository.

open_issues_count.description: The number of open issues and pull requests.

license.description: The repository license, or null when no license is detected.

name.description: The human-readable license name. Example: "MIT License".

spdx_id.description: The SPDX license identifier, or null when unavailable.

url.description: The API URL for the license, or null when unavailable.

node_id.description: The GraphQL node ID of the license.

is_template.description: Whether the repository is a template repository.

score.description: The search relevance score assigned to the repository by GitHub.

items.description: The repositories matching the search query.
